title: The para--Krawtchouk oscillator and its continuum limit
summary: The para--Krawtchouk polynomials define, through their recurrence relation, a finite oscillator model that carries out fractional revival. We determine the continuum limit of this Hamiltonian, both from its recurrence relation and directly on the polynomials. The limit is the singular (isotonic) oscillator $-\partial_η^2+η^2+\tfrac{γ^2-1}{4η^2}$: the deformation parameter $γ$ survives as a central impurity of the couplings, decaying as the inverse square of the distance --- the marginal rate, which the continuum scaling turns into a finite $1/η^2$ term.
